checks.evidence: At 1440x900 the Fleet stat strip wraps cleanly. No raw JSON or error text on Fleet, Inbox, Activity or Memory. At 1920x1080 the search box overlaps the stat strip (see bug 1). Recorded as passed with that bug attached; the main agent should judge it.

bugs.title: At 1920x1080 the top-bar search box covers the Fleet stat strip
bugs.evidence: Screenshots live-demo-board-assistant-fleet-1920.png and live-handsfree-email-booking-toast.png. 'SAVED CUST...' is cut off behind the 'Search vans, stops' box, and 'New stops' is hidden. It shows correctly at 1440x900, where the strip wraps to two rows. This is the judge-facing resolution.

bugs.title: The raw tool name 'explain_stop' shows in assistant replies
bugs.evidence: Chat bubble footer: 'explain_stop  BOOKED  Cobalt Therapeutics' and 'explain_stop BOOKED 3220 Grand Ave'. Also, one reply said 'I don't have the booking status or added cost from this result. (Cobalt Therapeutics: booked.)', which reads awkwardly.

bugs.title: Every other option repeats the best option's customer line, with mismatched times
bugs.evidence: Maya options: Van 2 at a 10:21am pickup shows 'Van 2 already passes 0.4 miles from you at 8:02am'. The Van 1 options show '...passes 2.4 miles from you at 4:28pm' for 10:41am and 1:12pm pickups. Van 3 shows 'at 8:08am' for a 3:21pm pickup. Nearly every option has a pass time hours away from its pickup.

notes: Add a request with auto-send on: pressing the price button (add-request-submit-button) auto-booked Maya at $15 on Van 2 ('Booked Maya, $15 instead of $55'). I never pressed Send. The customer is pasted text with no email address, so no real email went out. It still means 'price only' can't happen while auto-send is on.

The very first Open the demo of the session showed old fleet numbers on screen: 26 stops, Van 2 with 10 stops and 351 spare min, 'New stops: 3'. A curl right after showed /api/fleet already correct (24 stops, new_stops 2). It did not happen again in 4 later runs. It may be a race between the reset and the first fleet fetch.
Inbox times use the real clock while the demo clock says 10:00am. Requests made during the test are stamped '6:04 AM' and are listed after the 9:46 AM Priya row.
Driver page: the new stops are named by street address ('3220 Grand Ave') instead of 'Grand Lake Optometry'. The drop-off window (12:53pm to 1:24pm) starts before the pickup at 1:00pm.

The detail page for the morning booking (Lena) has no added-minutes, miles or cost breakdown; it only has the 'Quote: $15.00' line. Its WHAT WE READ section has no pickup or drop-off rows. The full math shows only on options for a newly priced request.

Backend lane skipped on purpose: the target is frozen live production and the rule is to change nothing. API facts were checked with read-only curls (fleet totals, inbox, memory rules, activity, customer/req-04, google/status connected).

Final step done: POST /api/demo/reset returned 200. After it: fleet totals stops 24 and new_stops 2; inbox req-01 and req-02 booked, req-03 needs_info. Gmail is still connected as emergentcouriers413@gmail.com. I changed no Settings and toggled no Memory rules.

action_items.detail: live-tricky-held-and-pricing failed only because of my test selector. Every app assertion it made passed, and the other-options listing is covered by live-detail-options-signout.
